userText:
Building: de Young Museum, San Francisco (museum).
The front (−z) is the entrance court on Music Concourse Drive.
Footprint: 157.2 m along x by 76.3 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (approximate: the hull of its OpenStreetMap parts), [x, z] in metres, going round:
[[-78.6,38.1],[-78.5,-38.1],[66,-37.7],[78.6,38.1]]
Height: the highest point is 44 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. wide three-quarter from the south-east access road: long low copper-clad box under palms with the twisted observation tower behind, blue sky
  2. close side view of the angular copper-clad wall and the sheared, twisting tower rising behind it, daylight
  3. front three-quarter from the street: low copper-clad volume with the tall twisted tower behind, palms in front, blue sky

Reply with the JSON object only.

json.notes: 1) The observation tower is far too narrow, about 10 m across in the top view against roughly 22-26 m in the photographs, so it reads as a small cube. 2) The tower does not dominate the body enough; it should rise to 44 m with its upper stages visibly overhanging and projecting beyond the lower ones, as in photos 2 and 3. 3) The body reads as a thin, flat slab with no sense of the angled copper walls, so I raise it slightly and keep it blank, with the tower placed further back and to the right as in photo 1.

photos: photo 1: the front three-quarter from the south-east access road, showing a long, low copper-clad box with a flat roof, a palm-lined front, and the tall stepped tower rising behind and to the right.
photo 2: a close side view of the angular copper-clad wall, with perforated panels, and the sheared, stacked tower rising behind it with projecting upper levels.
photo 3: the front three-quarter from the street, showing the low copper-clad volume with blank walls and the tall, tilted, stepped tower behind it on the right, under blue sky.

components.name: main copper body
components.why: photos 1 and 3: a long, low, flat-roofed copper-clad box with very few openings fills the footprint

components.name: stepped observation tower
components.where: rear right of the footprint, behind the front
components.why: photos 1, 2 and 3: a tall, perforated copper tower with stepped, projecting observation levels rises behind the body at the right

json.notes: The de Young is a long, low, copper-clad box with almost blank walls and a flat roof, filling most of the footprint at about 20 m. Its signature is the tall, perforated copper observation tower at the rear right (+x, +z), rising to 44 m in stepped, projecting levels that overhang one another. I model the body as a plain copper box and the tower as a stack of four square stages, alternating solid and open, with a flat top.
